Meet the gang

Alexis, her baby T-Rexes Snap and Daisy, and her best friend Abigail.

Alexis

Alexis is five years old and has two very special friends: baby T-Rexes named Snap and Daisy. Together they count, celebrate birthdays and play games, and Alexis is always ready to show them how things work.

Snap

Snap is the orange baby T-Rex. He's a boy with a big toothy grin, and he's always up for whatever Alexis has planned.

Daisy

Daisy is the blue baby T-Rex. She's a girl with a red bow and a big smile, and she loves joining in on every game.

Abigail

Abigail is Alexis' best friend. She comes over for a playdate in Hide and Seek, along with a pink baby T-Rex of her own.
